data.one_liner: Observable class to watch value changes via callbacks, Future or Stream.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple Observable that holds a value and notifies listeners when it changes. It exposes the next change as a Future and a continuous Stream. Supports optional equality checks and cancellation.
use_when: Need a tiny, dependency‑free way to react to value changes
Want to bridge Future/Stream APIs without pulling in a full state‑management library
avoid_when: Building a large‑scale app that requires scoped providers or advanced state handling
Need widget‑level integration like Consumer or selectors
strengths: Very lightweight – only depends on meta
Null‑safe and works on all Dart platforms
Simple API with Future, Stream and callback support
weaknesses: Limited to single value observation, no composition
No ecosystem features like debugging or devtools

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Full Flutter‑friendly state management with widget integration

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: More powerful, compile‑time safety and scoped providers
